content: {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s may see different navigation options at the bottom of the screen. The out-of-the-box tabs are Agenda, Info (Event details), Ticket (QR Code), Attendees (Attendee List), and More (additional configuration options). Please note that Event Organizers can change the tabs’ names to match their {{variable.Object_Event}} s better. Upcoming Events On the Upcoming Events page, you can see all the {{variable.Object_Event}} s you registered for. If you are registered for multiple {{variable.Object_Event}} s that are using the {{variable.Product_BlackthoEventNavigator}} app, you can swipe between {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Click Open Event to open an {{variable.Object_Event}} . Agenda On the Agenda page, you will see two tabs at the top of the screen: Full Agenda and My Agenda. The Full Agenda tab includes all of the {{variable.Object_Session}} s happening during the {{variable.Object_Event}} . My Agenda only consists of the {{variable.Object_Session}} s you have registered for. To refresh the screen, pull down on the screen. Full Agenda The Full Agenda page shows the name of the {{variable.Object_Event}} . If the {{variable.Object_Event}} happens over multiple days, you’ll see the days/dates of the {{variable.Object_Event}} ; clicking the day/date shows all the {{variable.Object_Session}} s, sorted by {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} , on that day. During a multi-day {{variable.Object_Event}} , the Full Agenda page will open on the current date if that day has {{variable.Object_Session}} s, making it easier to see what’s happening. You can also filter Sessions by Tracks by clicking the drop-down menu (upside-down triangle) next to the first day of the Event. Tracks separate Sessions by categories, making it easier to find a specific Session. Click on a {{variable.Object_Session}} to open a new page with information, such as the {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s name, description, start and end times, location, cost, and Speakers. (Clicking a Speaker opens a new page with the Speaker's image, name, and bio.) Click here to learn how to register for a {{variable.Object_Session}} . My Agenda Click the My Agenda tab to see the {{variable.Object_Session}} (s) you registered for. Click the {{variable.Object_Session}} to view its details (name, start and end dates, start and end times, and the description). Click here to learn how to cancel your registration for a {{variable.Object_Session}} . Info (Event Details) The Info tab includes details about the {{variable.Object_Event}} , such as the dates, times, location, description, and directions. Ticket (QR Code) Use the QR code to check in for your {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_Session}} (s). Attendees (Attendee List) The Attendees tab includes an alphabetical list of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who registered for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click here to learn how to search for {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s at your {{variable.Object_Event}} . NOTE: {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who have hidden their {{variable.Object_Attendee}} profile will not be visible. More Menu (Additional Configuration Options) Update Your Attendee Profile Click the “More” menu tab. Click on your name. Click the {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}} button. Update the following information. (You cannot change your first and last name.) X (Twitter) LinkedIn Instagram Click the “Hide from Attendee List?” toggle to remove your information from the Attendee List. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Change Organization For example, University A and University B both use Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Events}} , and each has an upcoming {{variable.Object_Event}} with the {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s {{variable.Field_EV_EnableNavigaAttMobApp}} field enabled. As an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} , I earned my undergraduate degree at University A and my graduate degree at University B. Each university represents an organization in the Navigator app, and I can switch between them to see information about the different {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Click the More tab. Click Change Organization . Select a new Organization. On the Upcoming Events page, select an {{variable.Object_Event}} from the new Organization. Switch Event Complete the following step to return to the Upcoming Events page or select a new {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click the More tab. Click Switch Event . You will be taken back to the Upcoming Events screen, where you can select another {{variable.Object_Event}} you registered for. Contact Us Blackthorn created the Navigator app; however, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who need assistance must use the app’s Contact Us feature to contact the Event Organizer. Blackthorn cannot assist individual {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. If the Contact Us form does not work, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s should reach out via the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage’s Contact Us form or by directly contacting the organization hosting the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click the More tab. Click Contact Us . Enter information in the following fields. First Name Last Name Email Subject Message Click {{variable.Button_Send}} . Blackthorn created the Navigator app; however, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who need assistance must use the app’s Contact Us feature to contact the Event Organizer. Blackthorn cannot assist individual {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. If the Contact Us form does not work, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s should contact the Event Organizer from the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage’s Contact Us form or by directly contacting the organization hosting the {{variable.Object_Event}} . If the Event Organizer needs additional information, they should open a case with {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} . Quick Start Click the More tab. Click Quick Start . Review the steps for an overview of how to use the app. Sign Out Click the More tab. Click Sign Out . Click Sign Out .
